FIELDS.NAME: Color Haven Paint & Wallpaper
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Color Haven Paint & Wallpaper operates as a retail establishment specializing in the sale of high-quality paints, wallpapers, and related home improvement supplies. Our primary focus is serving both residential and commercial customers, offering a wide range of products including eco-friendly and low-VOC paint options. We maintain a well-organized showroom where customers can benefit from in-store color matching and consultation services, helping them choose the perfect products for their projects. 

Our store is located within a commercial shopping center, equipped with standard security and fire protection systems, ensuring a safe shopping environment. We adhere strictly to all local, state, and federal regulations regarding the storage and disposal of products, and we train our staff thoroughly on the safe handling of materials. Additionally, we engage with our community by hosting workshops on painting and wallpaper techniques. Through effective inventory management and excellent customer service, we aim to meet the needs of our customers while minimizing risks associated with our operations.
FIELDS.OTHER BUSINESSES OWNED: Color Haven Home Decor LLC, a small subsidiary focusing on home accessories and decor items.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred during a break-in on 02/15/2023, resulting in theft of paint supplies and equipment valued at $2,500. Loss status: Closed. Water damage due to burst pipe on 05/22/2023, which caused $700 in repairs. Loss status: Closed.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sunday: 10:00 AM - 5:00 PM
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Floor-mounted safe, Class B, UL listed.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and monitored alarm system in place to deter theft and unauthorized access.
